description: User login result definition, including whether the user is an admin or observer, session ID, timestamp delta, and user ID.
guidance: Test the response structure of the user login API to ensure it includes all necessary fields such as is_admin, is_observer, session_id, timestamp_delta, timestamp_error, and user_id.

input.name: is_admin
input.description: Indicates if the user is an admin or not

input.name: is_observer
input.description: Indicates if the user is an observer or not

input.name: session_id
input.description: The allocated session ID for the user

input.name: timestamp_delta
input.description: The difference in seconds between the server datetime and local datetime

input.name: timestamp_error
input.description: Indicates if there is a timestamp error, requiring the local/chassis system datetime to be updated

input.name: user_id
input.description: The unique identifier for the user

description: User login request with parameters for name, observer, password, and signature.
guidance: To test this API, provide valid values for the user's name, observer mode, password, or signature. Ensure that the name meets the character set requirements and the password is securely provided or use a signature for enhanced security.

input.name: name
input.description: name of the user; length: 1-32; charset: _, 0-9, a-z, A-Z

input.name: observer
input.description: the default is empty, 1 is forced login, 2 is observer mode login

input.name: password
input.description: login password; choose one of signature and password. for the security of your account, it is recommended to log in with signature.

input.name: signature
input.description: login signature; rules:SHA-1 encryption of:name+timestamp(int)+SHA-1 encrypted password
